title: How is Grug connected to Napoleon?
description:
Grug from The Croods connects to Napoleon through Nicolas Cage, Elvis, two presidents and France's line of rulers.

Grug → Nicolas Cage → Lisa Marie Presley → Elvis Presley → Richard Nixon → Charles de Gaulle → Napoleon

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Grug → Nicolas Cage: Grug, the caveman dad of The Croods, is voiced by Nicolas Cage.
   Photo by DreamWorks Animation (via Entertainment Weekly), Georges Biard, Fair use (commentary) / CC BY-SA 3.0: https://www.filmofilia.com/the-croods-new-images-114199/ + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nicolas_Cage_Deauville_2013.jpg
2. Nicolas Cage → Lisa Marie Presley: In 2001, Cage sat beside Lisa Marie Presley at the Capitol, and the next year they married.
   Photo by Mark Wilson/Getty Images, Fair use (commentary): https://www.cbsnews.com/pictures/nicolas-cage/
3. Lisa Marie Presley → Elvis Presley: Her father was Elvis Presley, pictured here with baby Lisa Marie in 1968.
   Photo by United Press International (UPI), Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Elvis,_Priscilla_and_Lisa_Marie.jpg
4. Elvis Presley → Richard Nixon: In December 1970, Elvis showed up at the White House asking President Nixon for a narcotics badge.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Elvis-nixon.jpg
5. Richard Nixon → Charles de Gaulle: In 1969, Nixon flew to Paris to meet French President Charles de Gaulle.
   Photo by or not provided, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Nixon_and_staff_members_with_President_Charles_DeGaulle_of_France_-_NARA_-_194610.jpg
6. Charles de Gaulle → Napoleon (8 portraits, every holder): De Gaulle's France traces its line of rulers back to Napoleon, through kings and emperors.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:De_Gaulle-OWI_(cropped)_(c)(2).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_officiel_Vincent_Auriol.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raymond_Poincar%C3%A9_officiel_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Adolphe_Thiers_Nadar_2.JPG + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alexandre_Cabanel_002.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1841_portrait_painting_of_Louis_Philippe_I_(King_of_the_French)_by_Winterhalter.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:G%C3%A9rard_-_Louis_XVIII_of_France_in_Coronation_Robes.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jacques-Louis_David_-_The_Emperor_Napoleon_in_His_Study_at_the_Tuileries_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#grug #napoleon #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
